description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Order under the Registered Stock & Securities Ordinance  that direct to raise by way of loan in Sri Lanka - Reserved on 2107.01.01
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of legal/regulatory powers under the Registered Stock and Securities Ordinance to authorize the raising of government loans through Treasury Bonds. It cites specific legislative authorities (Ordinance No. 07 of 1937 and subsequent amendments) and contains detailed regulatory provisions governing the bond issuance, including interest rates, payment schedules, and maturity terms. While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake, it does so in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than focusing on personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter.
